description: Install two additional Wi-Fi access points at the gate before the tablets are installed.
justification: The signal survey confirmed risk RISK001: current coverage does not support the tablets at peak arrival times. Without the access points, check-in would rely on offline mode all the time, and the queue would no longer be visible in real time.

impacts.justification: Tablet installation moves from 22/04 to 27/04/2027. The 31/05 go-live date is kept.
Purchase and installation of two access points, already planned as the action for RISK001.
The gate network infrastructure becomes part of the scope.
The new access points are added to the corporate network.

risks_and_impacts.risks: The network team may be late in releasing the new access points.
risks_and_impacts.impacts: Without the change, the 8-minute target is at risk during peak hours.

execution_plan.activity: Install and configure on the network

notes: If approved, update the charter, the schedule and the status of RISK001 in the risk matrix.
